title: The Canon of the Bible
author: Samuel Davidson

authorInfo.bio: Samuel Davidson (1806–1898) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Canon of the Bible" by Samuel Davidson is a scholarly examination of the formation, history, and fluctuations of the Biblical canon, written in the late 19th century. The work seeks to provide a comprehensive and unbiased analysis of how the canon of both the Old and New Testaments developed over time, particularly in response to various critical perspectives.
